exely_rotated.title: Exely PMS webhook
exely_rotated.description:
⚠️ New values generated: the old key / URL no longer work. Enter the new ones in Exely now.

In Exely: Hotel settings → API connection → your connection → Webhooks: Use webhooks = Yes.
URL: {url}
(Exely requires https://. If the URL starts with http://, set the Internet URL to https://… in Settings → System → Network.)
Authentication: API key; key: {api_key}
Events: check-in and check-out only.

Rooms are matched automatically by name or number (Exely Room 01, 01 or 1 → Area Room 01) only when unambiguous. Other numbering (e.g. 101) must be mapped below.
